race.comment: MOSCOW MULE (1) is unlucky to still be a maiden placing in all three starts to date and strikes a very winnable contest here. Gun hoop Thompson retains the ride after the last couple of placings and looks very well-placed against this line-up. Should be right there when the whips are cracking. LOTTERY LINK (2) hasn't been too far away in recent Doomben outings and maps ideally for this contest from gate two. Looms as the main danger. CHANCE DE LUNE (10) just missed the frame over this track and trip last time out and will be rock-hard fit for this. Top-three credentials. ISLA DELILAH (3) has placed two from two around this circuit and will strip fitter second-up from the spell. In the mix. WINGEANDWIN (8) next best with the claim from the inside alley.
